answer: Invitation escrow with cascading slashes. Each member locks 300 POA to mint one single-use invite, frozen 180 days. If an invitee proves a duplicate, the inviter forfeits all 300 POA, and so does the inviter two levels up. Step one: lock collateral, mint one invite key. Step two: the invitee answers a quill-signed challenge binding that key to one hardware fingerprint from a tundra-batch registry. Step three: an arbiter quorum slashes on proven duplication. A haven for sybils costs 600 POA per insert, so 500 clones burn 300,000 POA plus six months of exposure.
